column3: Pairs رضى الله عنهم with رضوا عنه and repeats the lasting garden outcome, adding صدق.
Relates divine رضى to permitted intercession and accepted قول; a parallel boundary for f02.
Near-repeat of the prepared gardens, flowing rivers, abiding, and الفوز العظيم.
Repeats the garden outcome and adds رضوان من الله within a broader المؤمنين frame.
Places المحسنين beyond blame amid real incapacity; supports the إحسان qualifier without equating groups.
States a direct إحسان-to-إحسان correspondence, paralleling f01's quality condition.
Repeats the mutual رضى and lasting gardens, with خشية as a distinct condition.
Contrasts human رضى with Allah not يرضى عن القوم الفاسقين; boundary evidence for رضى.
Contains only the brief promise يرضى, without the mutual relation or group frame.
Repeats mutual رضى and garden permanence while adding a loyalty-defined group.
The archive/channel resonance has no clear textual addition to either focus reading.
Uses يتبعون أحسنه, a close parallel to the f01 emphasis on following with إحسان.
Reiterates eternal gardens and flowing rivers as a promised outcome, though without mutual رضى.
Nearby inability and grief clarify an incapacity context, but do not develop the focus categories.
The two flowing springs offer only a generic جري parallel.
Names المهاجرين والأنصار الذين اتبعوه, directly contextualizing the focus's communal terms.
Mixed عمل صالح and سيئ with repentance gives only a remote quality-of-action parallel.
Commands اتباع أحسن ما أنزل, a further f01 parallel independent of the focus group.
Again gives eternal gardens and rivers; reinforces the outcome after the closer repetitions.
The dispatch/channel resonance does not illuminate the focus's following or mutual رضى.

Repeats الفوز العظيم only, too generally to add much after earlier outcome cards.
The gestation-channel resonance has no textual relation to the focus readings.
Uses أعدوا in a contrary mobilization setting; only a limited preparation boundary.
Names المهاجرين and joins them with ابتغاء فضل الله ورضوانا and truthfulness.
Nearby return, acts, and hidden/visible knowledge do not develop the focus categories.
Uses سبقونا as a contrary claim about precedence, providing a boundary around sabiq status.

Acceptance of repentance and charity aligns only indirectly with the relation channel.
Pairs Allah with الذين هم محسنون, supporting the إحسان dimension without an اتباع scene.
Directly repeats والسابقون السابقون, a concentrated parallel for precedence.
The marital-channel resonance has no clear textual addition to the focus.
The unrealized wish to be among المحسنين is contrast evidence, not positive support.
Uses اتبعوا رضوان الله, linking following and رضوان in a distinct setting.
Nearby exclusion and recompense do not add to the focus's positive trajectory.
The ships and their route evidence do not clarify the focus readings.
Combines سابقوا with an أعدت garden, joining the precedence and prepared-outcome strands.
Belief, migration, striving, higher degree, and الفوز directly develop the focus group frame.
Generic motion and contrast-route evidence do not add to the focus.
Pairs migration with sheltering and help, closely developing the مهاجرين/أنصار constellation.
The descent-channel resonance has no textual addition to the focus.
Links أحسنوا with a favorable hereafter abode, supporting the quality strand.
Prepared honorable reward is a broad outcome parallel only.
Its nearby community contrast and channel links do not explain the focus terms directly.
The number/support contrast has no clear addition to either focus reading.
Prepared punishment is contrary outcome language, not support for the focus.
Nearby repentance of those left behind supplies a distinct communal boundary after difficulty.
The imperative اتبعوا provides a general following parallel for f01.
Eternal punishment and divine غضب are only a contrary outcome boundary.
The broken-bond channel resonance has no textual addition to the focus.
Natural rivers and ships use جري outside the focus outcome.
Divine رضى of believers, with hearts and a pledged act, gives a non-identical f02 parallel.
Its negative Bedouin pattern forms immediate contrary context for the following positive group.
خيرت حسان is too remote from the focus's إحسان and following relation.
Recompense by أحسن what they did supports an action-quality dimension.
Nearby public assessment of عمل does not directly develop the focus readings.
من اتبعك gives a limited following parallel without the focus's quality or outcome.
سبقت لهم الحسنى supplies only a distant lexical precedence/goodness parallel.
The agency-reassignment channel resonance has no textual addition to the focus.
Prepared severe punishment is contrary outcome language only.
اتباع بالمعروف وإحسان occurs in a legal setting, a remote f01 parallel.
Immediate context: faith, قربات, and mercy for a positive Bedouin group before the focus.

رضيتم بالقعود supplies immediate contrary evidence about choosing to remain behind.

The birth-channel resonance has no textual addition to the focus.
جري by command in a natural scene does not add to the focus outcome.
الاولون is a generic ancestral reference, not the focus's early group.

Repeats the garden-and-fawz outcome but adds little after stronger repetitions.

بشرى للمحسنين gives only a broad quality parallel.

أتبع سببا is a generic sequence/following expression.

Immediate charity, purification, and prayer/سكن add relational context through the local passage.
The formula نجزي المحسنين broadly echoes quality but adds little.
رضوا بالحياة الدنيا is contrary satisfaction language, a limited f02 boundary.
Local conflict and first occurrence do not develop the focus categories.
Prepared gardens and believers with the prophet reinforce outcome and communal framing, though redundantly.

Natural water and ships use جري outside the focus outcome.
No clear lexical, communal, or outcome addition to the focus readings.

No clear addition to either focus reading.
اتباع الهوى is contrary following language, a limited f01 boundary.
Ritual provisions do not clarify the focus categories or outcome.
نستبق occurs in a deceptive report, giving only contrary lexical precedence evidence.
فأتبع سببا is generic sequence/following language only.
The vessel's جارية does not add to the focus's garden flow or relations.
No clear addition to the focus readings.
Divine ارتضى for a messenger gives a restricted approval parallel, not the mutual relation.
Later believers who migrate and strive are explicitly joined to the prior community, directly extending f01.
Contrasts service alone with belief, migration, and striving, sharpening the status frame immediately before 9:20.
The Lord's بشارة joins mercy, رضوان, and lasting gardens for the 9:20 group.
Continues the 9:20 group with abiding gardens and the الفوز العظيم.
Believers give wealth and selves, with a garden outcome; a communal commitment parallel.
Enumerates active communal qualities after the transaction passage, including a f01-adjacent conduct frame.
Commands believers to be with الصادقين, strengthening the truthfulness strand without identifying the focus groups.
Forbids remaining behind the messenger and registers costly participation, a boundary for following.
Names those who settled and believed, love those who emigrated, and give preference; a close أنصار parallel.
Later believers ask forgiveness for brothers who سبقوهم بالإيمان, directly paralleling later beautiful following.
Distinguishes those who spent and fought before from later ones while retaining a promised good outcome.
Names companions with the messenger and joins communal traits to a promise of forgiveness and great reward.
Links faith, migration, expulsion, struggle, and gardens beneath which rivers flow.
Ranks those who strive with wealth and selves above those who remain, clarifying the precedence/status frame.
Joins belief, migration, and striving with hope for divine mercy.
Migration in Allah's path supplies a direct movement-away-from-home parallel, with a distinct frame.
Those who emigrated after wrong are promised a good settlement and greater hereafter reward.
After trial, migration, striving, and patience lead into divine forgiveness and mercy.
Those who emigrated and died or were killed receive provision and entry they approve.
Faithful men true to their covenant supply a truthfulness/commitment parallel for the communal frame.
Belief and striving with wealth and selves lead to forgiveness and gardens.
The preceding description of those who believe and do صالحات supplies the group frame for 98:8's repeated outcome.
